method: For each working end, working length is finished knotted length times the selected knotting factor, plus fringe. Folded mounting has two working ends per physical cut cord, so it doubles that working length; straight mounting has one. Mounting allowance is added once per physical cut cord. Base project length is cut length times the number of cut cords, purchase length adds the selected spare percentage, and whole rolls are purchase length divided by roll length and rounded up. Yards use the exact definition 1 yard = 0.9144 metres. The knotting factor is an explicit planning assumption rather than a prediction for a knot pattern; the tool recommends sampling dense or complex work and does not account for cord stretch, trimming beyond the entered fringe, or colour-lot requirements.
